items.title: Credo Technology Group Holding (CRDO) Secures OCP Approval For Two Optical Telemetry Standards
items.summary: Credo Technology Group Holding (NasdaqGS:CRDO) and Oracle secured OCP Community approval for two new optical telemetry specifications. Both specifications are intended to encourage broader industry use of consistent monitoring across optical modules used in AI fabrics.
